---
name: python-subprocess-bytes
description: Use when Python subprocess output decoding fails.
category: debugging
---
Capture arbitrary subprocess output as bytes with `capture_output=True, text=False`; decode only at the display boundary.
- Use `stdout.decode('utf-8', errors='replace')` for display when invalid bytes must not cause a crash.
- Preserve the original bytes for further binary processing; never use lossy decoding on that path.
- Verify with invalid UTF-8 such as `b'\xff'`: captured bytes must remain exact, and display decoding must succeed.
